author: blu
body: The kernel is which compiler builds the payload. It was not passed at all, so compile.ps1 fell back to whatever build.ps1 had last left in build-output/bare-metal, printing a NOTE that nothing read: two runs at the same commit could produce different depot images and neither would say so. The seed is the reproducible choice.

author: blu
body: The seed and the source both go on the image, unconditionally. They did not before. -Seed was never passed at all, so CODEX.CDX was never on the image while docs/UsersHandbook.md said it was. -Source was passed only when build-output/Codex.codex happened to exist, which is a scratch artifact build.ps1's concat phase leaves behind, so whether a stick carried its own source depended on whether somebody had run a build in that workspace recently. A stick that cannot verify or rebuild itself is not what this project promises anyone, so the concat is generated when missing rather than silently skipped.
